headline: OpenAI's Luna breaks through 5.7%, Poolside surges into top 10
summary: OpenAI's gpt-5.6-luna-20260709 hit an all-time high of 5.7% token share (day 2 of the streak), while Poolside's laguna-s-2.1 rocketed 37 spots in a week to crack the top 10 at 3.0%. DeepSeek still commands the overall market at 19.8%, but OpenAI's provider share jumped 5.9 points in a single day to 11.9%—its largest daily gain on record.
